contracts.docstring: Own pinned input/assets through spawn; never mounts broker control or home.
Keep analysis, Git sources and other base views readonly regardless of execution kind.
Pin the execution directory and compose isolated mounts before the broker can spawn its gated child.

Distinct native App Server transport profile; no credential mounts.

The broker selects readonly source access or write access to a prepared
private development copy. Network variants retain their own policy while
namespace/control calls remain denied.
Bind the inspected assets and trusted search mode to this capsule.
Admit writes only to a pinned private development view selected by fresh broker authority.
Account-free command RPC under a readonly source or explicitly selected private write view.
Private NET with a trusted FD relay and a stricter native child filter.
Keep the trusted discovery policy inside the original private network.
Execute only pinned Git under the original gate with a separate private allocation mount.
Expose the exact opened allocation; common readonly system aliases belong to the base capsule.

One externally supplied, non-reused domain for one original attempt.

``run_peer`` owns reserve→spawn→global publication→concrete local bind→G.
Callers receive a transport only after G and can only recover a receipt on
retry. ``revoke`` withdraws G before waiting for SQL/constructors. Global
recovery needs only the journal/domain, never the original project DB.
Complete actor-origin and endpoint authentication remain deployment work.
Retain one immutable source concession and record each operation's actual execution view.
Witness launch intent and manifests before releasing the original gate.
Own durable admission, fenced attempts and version-bound review requests in SQLite.
Validate dispatch against its actual ready view while retaining the original source registration.
Prepare a real private Git copy using the low-level development policy fixture and actual broker.
Actual native command RPC edits the prepared copy while its original source, credentials and network stay unavailable.
A development kind permits writes only in its native author profile, not diagnostic or Ken code.
Stop ends the actual writable namespace and preserves already-created private files for inspection.
The native actor profile shares the private mount policy; this probe uses only account-free command RPC.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
